svg.title: Tatara shared UI component board — Saṃskāra dark skin
svg.desc: A design-system contract board showing spacing, surfaces, typography, buttons, form states, selection controls, empty state, section heading, divider, and five-item bottom navigation.

g.text: Depth by restrained value shift, not decoration
Danger uses warm #C38658 only for a negative state or destructive action.
System font fallbacks · no decorative text in controls
52dp control height · 6dp radius · full surface is interactive
Outside label remains visible · field body is 52dp
Placeholder, when needed, is dimmer than entered text.
RESTING BORDER → ACCENT FOCUS → WARM ERROR → DIMMED DISABLED
Numbers align cleanly · unit remains inside trailing edge
Enter a value between 20 and 400 kg.
Minimum 48dp touch target for adjacent adjustment controls.
One connected control · selection is unmistakable
Unselected segments remain bordered and clearly tappable.
One surface · five destinations · 64dp item zones · selected accent marker, never a giant rectangle
SELECTED: ACCENT ICON + BRIGHT LABEL + 3DP MARKER

svg.text: SAṂSKĀRA TOKENS · GROUND #06120F · SURFACE #0B1D18 · RAISED #122A23 · HAIRLINE #214438 · MUTED #789487 · PRIMARY #E4F3E9 · ACCENT #62D497 · WARM #C38658
